sql:
Select
ROW_NUMBER()OVER(ORDER BY gid.SheetDate Desc) AS rowIndex,
gid.SheetSeries,CONVERT(Varchar(19),gid.SheetDate,21)SheetDate,gid.CustomerID,
pc.ShortName As CustomerName,gid.AddrDlv,gid.Remarks

FROM  dye.ClothGetMoney gid
left JOIN dye.p_Customer pc ON gid.CustomerID=pc.CustomerID
WHERE  1=1
And gid.SheetDate>=@dtStart And gid.SheetDate <=@dtEnd
And (ISNULL(@SheetSeries,'')='' Or gid.SheetSeries Like '%'+@SheetSeries+'%')
and  (ISNULL(@CustomerID,'')='' OR gid.CustomerID = @CustomerID)

Select SheetSeries,DetailNo,ProdID,FK.Name AS ProdName,Rolls,
'' ReceivingType,0.00 NetReceiptsRolls,0.00 NotReceivedRolls
from dye.ClothGetMoneyDetail a
Left Join (Select Code,Name from dye.p_FieldValid Where FieldType='FabricKind') FK On a.ProdID=FK.Code
Where SheetSeries In(Select SheetSeries from #t)

Select ROW_NUMBER()OVER(ORDER BY b.SheetDate Desc) AS rowIndex,
a.SheetSeries,a.DetailNo,CONVERT(Varchar(19),b.SheetDate,21) As SheetDate,
b.CustomerID,cu.ShortName AS CustomerName,b.AddrDlv,a.ProdID,FK.Name AS ProdName,
(a.Rolls - IsNull(ThisRolls,0))ResidueRolls

from dye.ClothGetMoneyDetail a Left JOin  dye.ClothGetMoney b On a.SheetSeries=b.SheetSeries
left Join dye.p_Customer cu On b.CustomerID=cu.CustomerID
Left Join (Select Code,Name from dye.p_FieldValid Where FieldType='FabricKind') FK On a.ProdID=FK.Code
where 1=1
And (ISNULL(@conFilter,'')='' OR cu.ShortName Like '%'+@conFilter+'%' Or a.DetailNo Like '%'+@conFilter+'%' Or FK.Name Like '%'+@conFilter+'%')
And ISnull(ThisRolls,0) < Rolls

Select ROW_NUMBER()OVER(ORDER BY b.SheetDate Desc) AS rowIndex,
a.SheetSeries,a.DetailNo,CONVERT(Varchar(19),b.SheetDate,21) As SheetDate,
CONVERT(Varchar(19),a.ReceivingDate,21) ReceivingDate,
b.Driver,Dr.Name As DriverName,a.AddrDlv,a.CustomerID,cu.ShortName As  CustomerName,a.ProdID,FK.Name As ProdName,
Isnull(Rolls,0) Rolls,IsNull(ReceivingType,0) ReceivingType,
Case When ISNull(ReceivingType,0)=0  Then '未收货'
When IsNull(ReceivingType,0)=1  Then '已收货'
When IsNull(ReceivingType,0)=2  Then '部分收获'
When IsNull(ReceivingType,0)=3  Then '暂时不收货' End ReceivingTypeName,
IsNUll(ReceivingRolls,0) ReceivingRolls,(Isnull(Rolls,0) - IsNUll(ReceivingRolls,0)) ResidueRolls

from dye.GetClothNoticeDetail a Left JOin  dye.GetClothNotice b On a.SheetSeries=b.SheetSeries
left Join dye.p_Customer cu On a.CustomerID=cu.CustomerID
Left Join (Select Code,Name from dye.p_FieldValid Where FieldType='FabricKind') FK On a.ProdID=FK.Code
Left Join (Select Code,Name from dye.p_FieldValid Where FieldType='Driver') Dr On b.Driver=Dr.Code
Where 1=1
And a.ReceivingDate>=@dtStart And a.ReceivingDate <@dtEnd
and  (ISNULL(@CustomerID,'')='' OR a.CustomerID = @CustomerID)
And (ISNULL(@Driver,'')='' Or b.Driver =@Driver)

Select
ROW_NUMBER()OVER(ORDER BY b.DetailNo Desc) AS rowIndex,
CONVERT(Varchar(19),a.SheetDate,21)As SheetDate,
a.SheetNo,
b.DetailNo,
a.CustomerID,
p.ShortName As CustomerName,
b.JobSheetNo,
b.ProdID,
Gr.NameC As ProdName,
b.ColorID,
b.ColorNum,
b.Rolls,
b.GrayQty,
b.WeightQty,
b.LengthQty

FROM dye.ProdOut a
INNER JOIN dye.ProdOutDetail b ON b.SheetSeries = a.SheetSeries
LEFT JOIN dye.JobSheet j ON j.SheetNo=b.JobSheetNo
LEFT JOIN dye.p_Customer p ON p.CustomerID = a.CustomerID
left Join dye.p_Gray Gr on Gr.GrayID=b.ProdID
Where 1=1
And EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dye.ProdLoadingDetail pl
LEFT JOIN dye.ProdLoading pd ON pd.SheetSeries = pl.SheetSeries WHERE b.DetailNo=pl.OutDetailNo AND pd.RightStatus=10)
And a.SheetDate>=@dtStart And a.SheetDate <@dtEnd
and  (ISNULL(@CustomerID,'')='' OR a.CustomerID = @CustomerID)
and  (ISNULL(@ProdID,'')='' OR b.ProdID = @ProdID)
and  (ISNULL(@ColorNum,'')='' OR b.ColorNum = @ColorNum)
and  (ISNULL(@JobSheetNo,'')='' OR b.JobSheetNo like '%'+ @JobSheetNo +'%')

Select
ROW_NUMBER()OVER(ORDER BY b.DetailNo Desc) AS rowIndex,

left Join dye.p_Gray Gr on Gr.GrayID=b.ProdID

and  (ISNULL(@CustomerID,'')='' OR a.CustomerID = @CustomerID)
and  (ISNULL(@ProdID,'')='' OR b.ProdID = @ProdID)
and  (ISNULL(@ColorNum,'')='' OR b.ColorNum = @ColorNum)
and  (ISNULL(@JobSheetNo,'')='' OR b.JobSheetNo like '%'+ @JobSheetNo +'%')

Select SheetSeries,a.CustomerID,b.ShortName As CustomerName ,a.AddrDlv,a.Remarks from dye.ClothGetMoney a
left join dye.p_Customer b On a.CustomerID=b.CustomerID
Where SheetSeries=@SheetSeries

Select SheetSeries,DetailNo,ProdID,FK.Name AS ProdName,Rolls from dye.ClothGetMoneyDetail a
Left Join (Select Code,Name from dye.p_FieldValid Where FieldType='FabricKind') FK On a.ProdID=FK.Code
Where SheetSeries=@SheetSeries
SELECT * FROM dye.dyeCheckout WHERE EndTime>=@startdate AND EndTime<=@enddate AND (@colormatching='合计汇总' OR (ColorMatching=@colormatching AND ClassID=@classid))

SELECT Days,SUM(WeightQty)WeightQty
FROM dye.vw_ProdOut_Query WHERE Days>=@dsDate AND Days<= @dtDate GROUP BY Days

SELECT x.Years,''AS RQ,x.ShiftID,x.JobSheetNo,x.Kind,x.EmpID,x.SK_Qty

FROM (
SELECT AR.JobSheetNo,'A' AS Kind,EmpID,SUM(SK_Qty) AS SK_Qty,'' AS ShiftID,'' AS Years FROM dye.A_RSGX AR
WHERE 1=1
AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #T_A WHERE #T_A.JobSheetNo=AR.JobSheetNo)
GROUP BY AR.JobSheetNo,EmpID
UNION ALL
SELECT AR.JobSheetNo,'B' AS Kind,'HF0000' AS EmpID,SUM(SK_Qty) AS SK_Qty,'' AS ShiftID,'' AS Years FROM dye.A_RSGX AR
WHERE 1=1
AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #T_A WHERE #T_A.JobSheetNo=AR.JobSheetNo)
GROUP BY AR.JobSheetNo
UNION ALL
SELECT JobSheetNo,'C' AS Kind,ColorMatching AS EmpID,1 AS SK_Qty,'' AS ShiftID,'' AS Years FROM dye.JobSheetRegister JR
WHERE 1=1
AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #T_A WHERE #T_A.JobSheetNo=JR.JobSheetNo)
GROUP BY JobSheetNo,ColorMatching
)x
temps.t_b:
SELECT * 
FROM (SELECT
Y.JobSheetNo,
J.ColorID,
J.ColorNum,
'OK'AS LaoDu,
DB.KindName AS PinZhong,
CONVERT(INT,RIGHT(DB.RSKind,2)) AS DaiHao,
J.ProdID,
JR.Rolls,
JR.WeightQty,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dye.StuffWeightPhase A
LEFT JOIN dye.StuffWeight B ON B.SheetSeries = A.SheetSeries
LEFT JOIN (SELECT  * FROM dye.p_FieldValid WHERE FieldType='DyePhase')PF ON PF.Code=A.PhaseID
WHERE B.JobSheetNo=Y.JobSheetNo AND PF.Name LIKE '%后处理%') AS GuSheChiShu,
(SELECT MAX(B.AddColorNum) FROM dye.StuffWeightPhase A
LEFT JOIN dye.StuffWeight B ON B.SheetSeries = A.SheetSeries
WHERE B.JobSheetNo=Y.JobSheetNo AND B.SheetKind=2 AND B.RecipeType=1) AS JiaSheChiShu,
(SELECT TOP 1 W.StartTime FROM dye.WProcess W WHERE W.JobSheetNo=Y.JobSheetNo AND W.ProcessID='GX07' ORDER BY W.StartTime ASC)AS InDate,
(SELECT TOP 1 W.StartTime FROM dye.WProcess W WHERE W.JobSheetNo=Y.JobSheetNo AND W.ProcessID='GX07' AND W.DyeState IN ('3','4','7') ORDER BY W.StartTime DESC) AS OutDate,
JR.ShiftID,
JR.ColorMatching,
(SELECT TOP 1 LEFT(W.MachineID,1) FROM dye.WProcess W WHERE W.JobSheetNo=Y.JobSheetNo AND W.ProcessID='GX07' AND ISNULL(MachineID,'')<>'')AS GangXing
FROM (SELECT DISTINCT JobSheetNo FROM #T_WorkSumNew)Y
LEFT JOIN dye.JobSheetRegister JR ON JR.JobSheetNo = Y.JobSheetNo
LEFT JOIN dye.JobSheet J ON J.SheetNo=Y.JobSheetNo
LEFT JOIN dye.p_Gray PG  ON PG.GrayID=J.ProdID
LEFT JOIN(SELECT KeyValue AS RSKind,DisplayValue AS KindName FROM dye.s_DBComboValue WHERE ComboID='Z017')DB ON DB.RSKind = PG.RSKind
)z
WHERE 1=1
AND z.OutDate>=@StartTime
AND z.OutDate< @EndTime

temps.t_worksumnew:
SELECT C.Years,
C.ShiftID,
C.RQ,
C.EmpID,
SUM(C01_Q)C01_Q,
SUM(C02_Q)C02_Q,
SUM(C03_Q)C03_Q,
SUM(C01_A)C01_A,
SUM(C02_A)C02_A,
SUM(C03_A)C03_A,
SUM(T_Q)T_Q,
SUM(T_A)T_A,
SUM(Sum_A)Sum_A

FROM
(SELECT
CONVERT(VARCHAR(4),B.RQ) AS Years,
CONVERT(VARCHAR(100),'') AS ShiftID,
B.RQ,
B.EmpID,
B.C01_Q,
B.C02_Q,
B.C03_Q,
B.C01_A,
B.C02_A,
B.C03_A,
B.T_Q,
B.T_A,
B.C01_A+B.C02_A+B.C03_A+B.T_A AS Sum_A
FROM
(SELECT
A.RQ,
A.EmpID,
CONVERT(DECIMAL(8,2),IIF(ISNULL(DB.ZTKind,'')='C01'AND A.ProcessID='GX03',A.SK_Qty,0))AS C01_Q,
CONVERT(DECIMAL(8,2),IIF(ISNULL(DB.ZTKind,'')='C02'AND A.ProcessID='GX03',A.SK_Qty,0))AS C02_Q,
CONVERT(DECIMAL(8,2),IIF(ISNULL(DB.ZTKind,'')='C03'AND A.ProcessID='GX03',A.SK_Qty,0))AS C03_Q,
CONVERT(DECIMAL(8,2),IIF(ISNULL(DB.ZTKind,'')='C01'AND A.ProcessID='GX03',[dye].[fn_ProcessIDPrice](A.JobSheetNo,A.ProcessID,1)*A.SK_Qty,0))AS C01_A,
CONVERT(DECIMAL(8,2),IIF(ISNULL(DB.ZTKind,'')='C02'AND A.ProcessID='GX03',[dye].[fn_ProcessIDPrice](A.JobSheetNo,A.ProcessID,1)*A.SK_Qty,0))AS C02_A,
CONVERT(DECIMAL(8,2),IIF(ISNULL(DB.ZTKind,'')='C03'AND A.ProcessID='GX03',[dye].[fn_ProcessIDPrice](A.JobSheetNo,A.ProcessID,1)*A.SK_Qty,0))AS C03_A,
CONVERT(DECIMAL(8,2),IIF(A.ProcessID='GX04',A.SK_Qty,0)) AS T_Q,
CONVERT(DECIMAL(8,2),IIF(A.ProcessID='GX04',[dye].[fn_ProcessIDPrice](A.JobSheetNo,A.ProcessID,1)*A.SK_Qty,0)) AS T_A
FROM dye.A_PTGX A
LEFT JOIN dye.JobSheet J ON A.JobSheetNo=J.SheetNo
LEFT JOIN dye.p_Gray PG ON PG.GrayID=J.ProdID
LEFT JOIN(SELECT KeyValue AS ZTKind,DisplayValue AS KindName FROM dye.s_DBComboValue WHERE ComboID='Z016')DB ON DB.ZTKind = PG.ZTKind
WHERE 1=1
AND A.StationID='03'
AND A.RQDate>=@StartTime
AND A.RQDate< @EndTime
)B
)C
WHERE 1=1
GROUP BY Years,ShiftID,RQ,EmpID
